name: shorlist
description: ShorList v0.3.0, an open catalogue of 2099 forms in which cryptographic algorithms appear in code and configuration, each with a primary source, plus decoys. One skill looks up rows and their sources, and explains how to score a scanner with the generator in the ShorList repository. Skills only: works in claude.ai chat, Cowork and Claude Code. No hooks, no MCP server, no network requests. It is not a scanner.
